blocks.text: The thyroid is a butterfly-shaped gland of two connected lobes on either side of the trachea at the front of the neck. It is often called the body's master controller of metabolism, because its hormones set how fast every cell works.

items: Thyroxine (tetra-iodothyronine, T4) and tri-iodothyronine (T3): the thyroid makes much more T4, which is converted into T3, the more active form. They raise heart rate and breathing rate, stimulate cellular respiration and set the basal metabolic rate, increase glucose breakdown and cholesterol synthesis in the liver, and in children promote growth of the skeleton and development of the brain.
Calcitonin: helps keep blood calcium at the proper level; when blood calcium rises too high, it makes calcium move into the bones, lowering the level in the blood.
Hypothyroidism (too little): growth retardation, lethargy, weight gain, constipation, high cholesterol, low heart rate and low body temperature.
Cretinism: hypothyroidism during foetal and childhood development, causing stunted growth and mental retardation.
Myxoedema: a rare, life-threatening result of severe hypothyroidism, with mucopolysaccharides building up in connective tissue so that the skin and tissues swell and thicken.
Goitre: swelling of the thyroid when hypothyroidism is caused by iodine deficiency.
Hyperthyroidism (too much): weight loss and high blood pressure, heart rate and body temperature.

blocks.title: Graves' disease
blocks.text: Graves' disease is an autoimmune disease that causes hyperthyroidism, often with an enlarged thyroid. Symptoms include irritability, muscle weakness, sleep problems, fast heartbeat, poor tolerance of heat, diarrhoea, weight loss and thickened skin on the shins; the eyeballs may protrude (exophthalmia).

blocks.prompt: Why can lack of iodine cause goitre?
blocks.explanation: Iodine is needed to make the thyroid hormones (their names show the iodine atoms, tri- and tetra-iodo). Without enough, hormone levels fall (hypothyroidism) and the gland swells. (The link through TSH is general biology.)

items: Thyroid: T4 and T3 set the metabolic rate and support growth; calcitonin lowers blood calcium.
Too little: hypothyroidism, cretinism, myxoedema, goitre; too much: hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease).
